context: A startup is actively trying to reduce LLM inference cost without lowering support quality.
signal: A new model provider claims similar quality at 45% lower cost.
reason: Current cost bottleneck exists; claims need representative benchmark before adoption.

context: A team is focused on shipping a payments workflow; Office document generation is not blocking any deliverable.
signal: A popular open-source Office CLI gains 20,000 stars.
reason: Interesting capability, but no current fit or defined project trigger.

context: Three enterprise prospects independently ask for evidence of agent approval and audit controls.
signal: A competitor launches an agent-governance dashboard.
reason: Observed buyer need exists; validate offer and willingness to pay before broad build.

context: Production tool calls sometimes retry after timeouts and duplicate effects; postcondition checks are absent.
signal: A verified pattern shows postcondition verification plus idempotency keys reduce non-atomic tool failures.
reason: Directly addresses a verified current reliability failure mode with understood pattern.

context: An internal signal-to-decision gate has been used successfully across multiple teams and users ask to reuse it.
signal: The team considers packaging the internal gate as a portable agent skill.
reason: Internal usefulness is demonstrated and external reusable demand is emerging.

context: Current workloads are stable; no latency or cost issue relates to model architecture.
signal: A novel diffusion language-model architecture trends on social media.
reason: No current fit, value path, bounded test, or specific revisit trigger.
